message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks survivable eastern separation by holding a nearly level eastbound course while accelerating, given that B0100 remained behind to the northwest and opposing missile tracks occupied that same sector rather than presenting favorable attack geometry.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to reduce vulnerability to pursuit and possible missile interception by converting altitude into speed during a southeast extension with repeated hard lateral corrections, given the nearby B-team missile tracks and B0100’s later launch into the same corridor; its turn-away geometry does not support an attack run."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks survivable eastern separation by holding a nearly level eastbound course while accelerating, given that B0100 remained behind to the northwest and opposing missile tracks occupied that same sector rather than presenting favorable attack geometry.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to reduce vulnerability to pursuit and possible missile interception by converting altitude into speed during a southeast extension with repeated hard lateral corrections, given the nearby B-team missile tracks and B0100’s later launch into the same corridor; its turn-away geometry does not support an attack run.
